subsidy.en: The government subsidy helped the community replace old equipment.
subsidy.zh: 政府補助幫助社區汰換老舊設備。

subtract.en: Remember to subtract the smaller number from the larger one.
subtract.zh: 記得用較大的數減去較小的數。

suburb.en: The family moved to a quiet suburb near the city.
suburb.zh: 這家人搬到城市附近安靜的郊區。

suburban.en: The train connects several suburban neighborhoods with downtown.
suburban.zh: 這班火車連接數個郊區社區和市中心。

subway.en: We took the subway to the museum during the class trip.
subway.zh: 班級旅行時，我們搭地鐵前往博物館。

succeed.en: Students often succeed when they practice consistently and ask questions.
succeed.zh: 學生持續練習並主動提問時，往往更容易成功。

succession.en: Three rainy days occurred in succession during the holiday.
succession.zh: 假日期間連續三天下雨。

successor.en: The new principal was introduced as the successor to the retiring leader.
successor.zh: 新校長被介紹為退休校長的接任者。

sue.en: The article explains why a company may sue over a contract dispute.
sue.zh: 文章說明公司為何可能因合約爭議提起訴訟。

suffer.en: Plants may suffer when they receive too little sunlight.
suffer.zh: 植物日照不足時可能生長不良。

sugar.en: The recipe uses less sugar than the original version.
sugar.zh: 這份食譜比原版使用更少的糖。

suggestion.en: Her suggestion helped the group finish the project more efficiently.
suggestion.zh: 她的建議幫助小組更有效率地完成專題。

suit.en: This quiet room will suit students who need to concentrate.
suit.zh: 這間安靜的房間很適合需要專心的學生。

suitable.en: The teacher chose a suitable article for the class discussion.
suitable.zh: 老師選了一篇適合課堂討論的文章。

suitcase.en: He packed his books carefully inside a small suitcase.
suitcase.zh: 他把書仔細收進一個小行李箱。

suite.en: The hotel suite includes a bedroom and a small sitting area.
suite.zh: 這間飯店套房包含臥室和一個小客廳。

sum.en: The final sum includes the cost of materials and transportation.
sum.zh: 最後總額包含材料費和交通費。

summary.en: Write a short summary after reading the article carefully.
summary.zh: 仔細讀完文章後，寫一段簡短摘要。

summit.en: The hikers reached the summit just before the clouds arrived.
summit.zh: 健行者在雲層抵達前登上山頂。

summon.en: The principal may summon the committee for an urgent meeting.
summon.zh: 校長可能召集委員會召開緊急會議。

sun.en: The sun appeared again after the morning rain stopped.
sun.zh: 早上的雨停後，太陽又出現了。

sunny.en: We moved the activity outdoors because the afternoon was sunny.
sunny.zh: 因為下午天氣晴朗，我們把活動移到戶外。

super.en: The new computer is super fast compared with the old one.
super.zh: 和舊電腦相比，新電腦速度超快。

superb.en: Her superb presentation earned praise from the judges.
superb.zh: 她出色的簡報獲得評審稱讚。

superficial.en: A superficial reading may miss the article's main argument.
superficial.zh: 只做表面閱讀可能會錯過文章的主要論點。

superintendent.en: The school superintendent visited several campuses during the week.
superintendent.zh: 學區主管這週造訪了好幾所學校。

superior.en: The newer material proved superior in strength and durability.
superior.zh: 較新的材料在強度和耐用性方面表現更好。

supermarket.en: The supermarket added more self-checkout machines near the entrance.
supermarket.zh: 超市在入口附近增設更多自助結帳機。

superstition.en: The lesson examines how superstition can develop in different cultures.
superstition.zh: 課堂探討迷信如何在不同文化中形成。

superstitious.en: The character is superstitious and avoids certain numbers for luck.
superstitious.zh: 那個角色很迷信，會避開某些數字求好運。

supervise.en: A teacher will supervise the laboratory activity this afternoon.
supervise.zh: 今天下午會有老師監督實驗活動。

supervision.en: The younger students completed the activity under teacher supervision.
supervision.zh: 年幼學生在老師監督下完成活動。

supervisor.en: The project supervisor reviewed our schedule before the presentation.
supervisor.zh: 專題指導老師在發表前檢查了我們的時程。

supper.en: The family ate a simple supper after returning home late.
supper.zh: 一家人晚歸後吃了一頓簡單晚餐。

supply.en: The school keeps an extra supply of paper in the office.
supply.zh: 學校在辦公室備有額外紙張。

suppose.en: I suppose the meeting will end before six o'clock.
suppose.zh: 我想會議應該會在六點前結束。

supposedly.en: The old building is supposedly more than a century old.
supposedly.zh: 據說這棟老建築已有一百多年歷史。

supreme.en: The court serves as the supreme legal authority in the system.
supreme.zh: 這座法院是該制度中的最高司法機關。

surf.en: Visitors can surf safely only in areas marked for the activity.
surf.zh: 遊客只能在標示可進行活動的區域衝浪。

surface.en: The table has a smooth surface that is easy to clean.

surge.en: The station saw a surge in passengers after the concert ended.
surge.zh: 演唱會結束後，車站旅客人數突然增加。

surname.en: Please write your surname in the final box on the form.
surname.zh: 請在表格最後一格填寫你的姓氏。

surpass.en: This year's attendance may surpass the record set last year.
surpass.zh: 今年的出席人數可能超越去年的紀錄。

surplus.en: The school donated its surplus books to a community center.
surplus.zh: 學校把多餘的書捐給社區中心。

surprise.en: The class prepared a surprise for their teacher after the ceremony.
surprise.zh: 典禮後，全班為老師準備了一個驚喜。

surprised.en: We were surprised by how quickly the experiment produced results.
surprised.zh: 我們對實驗這麼快得到結果感到驚訝。

surround.en: Tall trees surround the small lake behind the school.
surround.zh: 高大的樹木環繞著學校後方的小湖。

surroundings.en: The hikers stopped to observe their surroundings before choosing a path.
surroundings.zh: 健行者先停下觀察周遭環境，再選擇路線。

survival.en: The documentary explains how desert plants adapt for survival.
survival.zh: 紀錄片說明沙漠植物如何適應環境以生存。

survive.en: Some seeds can survive cold winters and grow in spring.
survive.zh: 有些種子可以熬過寒冬並在春天生長。
